surface: Dashboard /dashboard (S1 opening frame) and case queue /cases: Dashboard.razor, CasesPage.razor, Common/StatCard, ActivityRings, AreaChart, Crs/Segmented, DaysLeft, plus the data from Features/Cases, Changes, Deadlines, Audit, Evaluation
state_today: 655ebee, live EN: header 'Welcome back, Ana'; 4 StatCards (Open 7, Due in 7 days 1, Waiting for approval 1, Escalated 1); Next deadlines bars (6 of 7 open, 2 of them FATCA dashed bars); rings by who the case waits for; decisions parsed from audit payloads (14 changes: 5 no case, 2 compliant, 4 clarification, 3 FATCA); 6 recent changes. The data is real, but screened volume and no-case work are below the fold. /cases: 4 segments, search, header row; no sorting, no All/Escalated view, no bulk actions. What fits by 08:00: items 1-5, 8, 10, 12-15 (~6 h).

items.title: S1 frame: replace the four 1-1-1 KPI cards with a screening-flow band
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:63-74: all four StatCards come from the same 7 open cases (live EN: 7/1/1/1). Screened volume and no-case work only show below the fold, in 'Decisions of the code' (:116-129). PITCH.md:57 voice: every update evaluated, only tax-relevant ones start a deadline.
items.proposal: One full-width band of connected steps, filled left to right once: Changes received 14 (25 clients) -> Decided by code 14, 0 waiting -> No case needed 7 (5 no indicium, 2 covered) | Case needed 7 -> 4 CRS deadlines, next in 4 days | 3 FATCA, no deadline in guide (p. 38) -> Needs a person today 1. Label decisions and cases apart. Stack at 390px.
items.data_source: _changes/_decisions from IAuditLog.ListAsync (change.received payload: decision, kind, engineVersion); IClientService.ListAsync().Count; ICaseService.QueueAsync DueAt/Regime/RemindedAt; _drafts

items.title: Generic 'Welcome back, Ana' header and starter description in the opening shot
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:18 title 'Welcome back, {0}'; the description is SiteConfig.Description (SiteConfig.cs:15-17): 'Every change to a customer's data...', while every CRS page says client. HANDOFF §7: dashboard still generic.
items.proposal: Statement header with live numbers: title T("{0} changes in. {1} needed a case."), description T("Every change is evaluated by code against the ANAF guide; only tax-relevant ones start a deadline."). Keep the Cases / New change buttons. Use dashboard-only keys so the landing copy stays as it is.

items.title: 'Reminder day has passed' hint is computed from the 7-day window, not from the reminder
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:64,70: urgent = DaysBetween(now, DueAt) <= 7, and then the hint says the reminder day has passed. The reminder is DueAt minus 5 days (DeadlineCalculator.cs:30,47). Today it is right only by chance (CRS-2026-0002, 4 days left); a case with 6-7 days left gets a false statement.
items.proposal: Build the hint from Case.RemindedAt: '{0} past the reminder day, escalated' when any; otherwise 'Next reminder on {date}' from the earliest RemindAt among open cases.

items.title: Escalated case counted as 'waiting for the client' while its card says 'with the tax department'
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:197-202: Operator() = Open or ResponseReceived, so Escalated lands in 'The client'. :73-74 says 'With the tax department'. The escalated case also holds a reminder draft that only the operator can send (CaseService.cs:806-822). One screen gives two answers.
items.proposal: Replace the rings with 'Who acts next' bar rows (crs-decision-row): Operator (draft to approve, file to prepare, answer to close), Client (AwaitingClient), Tax department (Escalated, no draft), Done. ActivityRings draws at most 3 segments (ActivityRings.razor:4), so use bars.
items.data_source: QueueAsync Status + _drafts (GetAsync Requests per open case)

items.title: No 'cases by status' view, although PITCH S1 promises one
items.evidence: PITCH.md:59: S1 shows 'termenele care expiră în 7 zile și cazurile pe stări'. The dashboard has deadlines and rings by who the case waits for (Dashboard.razor:106-112), but no status breakdown. CaseStages and CrsUi.Stage already define the 4 stages.
items.proposal: A pipeline strip: Opened 6 -> Awaiting client / reminded / escalated 1 -> Answer received 0 -> Closed with proof 0 / Expired 0. Each stage links to /cases?view=. Reuse the CaseStages labels and icons so S1 and S2 look alike. Can share one card with 'Who acts next'.

items.title: Deadline horizon: every CRS deadline on one 90-day ruler
items.evidence: 'Next deadlines' (Dashboard.razor:76-104) is 6 separate bars with no reminder-day mark. 2 of the 6 rows are FATCA dashed bars that carry no information, and a per-case list does not read as bank scale.
items.proposal: One ruler like the case page DeadlineClock: a today cursor, the last 5 days shaded (reminder zone), one dot per open CRS case at elapsed/total, code and client on hover. Fold FATCA into one line: '3 FATCA cases: no deadline in the guide (p. 38)'. Keep a top-4 list below it.
items.data_source: QueueAsync OpenedAt, DueAt, RemindAt, DeadlineGuidePage; CrsUi.DaysBetween/DayNumber with ISimClock.UtcNow

items.title: Next-deadline rows say who, but not why
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:98: the row meta is name and regime only. The queue already carries Indicia, DeadlineRuleId, DeadlineGuidePage and RemindAt (Case.cs:25-42; CaseService.cs:125 includes Indicia).
items.proposal: Meta 'Irina Constantin · Address in Spain' (CrsUi.ShortRule + CrsUi.Country of the first indicium). DaysLeft title 'DL-NEW-90 · guide p. 20-21, 35-36'. A 2px tick on each bar at RemindAt. Replace the FATCA rows with one summary line.

items.title: Awkward or demo-scaffolding English on the dashboard and /cases
items.evidence: 'Who the cases wait for' (Dashboard.razor:108); 'Decisions of the code' / 'On the last {0} changes' (:116-117); 'Open cases on the demo date, the closest first' (:81); CasesPage.razor:12 'ordered by deadline on the demo date'; DaysLeft.razor:16 '{0} d overdue'; SiteConfig.cs:17 'customer's'.
items.proposal: Use 'Who acts next', 'Decided by code', 'Last {0} changes', 'Open cases, closest deadline first', 'Ordered by deadline. FATCA cases have no deadline in the guide and come last.', '{0} days overdue', 'client's'. New EN keys with RO values; grep every Lang.Ro*.cs for duplicates first.

items.title: Trust strip in the opening frame: audit chain, rule checks with guide pages, shield scans
items.evidence: The dashboard shows nothing of what S7 and S9 claim. IAuditLog.VerifyAsync (AuditLog.cs:132-136) is read-only and cheap. Each rule.applied payload carries rule, page and applied (ChangeService.cs:365-369). Clean scans are change.received entries with engineVersion 'shield'.
items.proposal: One quiet line under the band: 'Audit chain intact · {Checked} entries · verified {time}' (red, with the Seq, after a tamper); '{n} rule checks, each with its guide page · {m} verified, do not apply'; '{k} documents scanned by the shield'. Links to /audit and /metrics.
items.data_source: IAuditLog.VerifyAsync(); IAuditLog.ListAsync rule.applied (applied, page) and change.received (engineVersion == ChangeService.ShieldVersion)

items.title: Shield-scanned documents appear as 'No case' in Recent changes
items.evidence: Live EN: 'Document uploaded · Marius Stoica · No case' appears twice in the top 6 (Dashboard.razor:137-148). ShieldOutcome returns Decision.NoCase with engineVersion 'shield' (ChangeService.cs:357-363); Parse ignores engineVersion (:209-221). The pill tooltip 'No rule from the guide applies' is wrong for a scan.
items.proposal: Parse engineVersion. For the shield, show a neutral 'Scanned, clean' pill (or Shield alert), and count scans apart from rule decisions in the decisions card.

items.title: After S4, four seeded cases expire and the dashboard has no place for outcomes
items.evidence: Closed and expired cases appear only in the '{0} closed or expired' hint (Dashboard.razor:68). Moving to Maria's day 85 (+85 d, CaseDetailPage.razor:304-305) expires CRS-2026-0002/3/1/4 (4, 43, 64, 78 days left) in TickAsync (CaseService.cs:834). A post-run dashboard reads as missed deadlines.
items.proposal: In the pipeline's last stage: 'Closed with proof N · {d} days to spare' (DueAt minus ClosedAt) and 'Expired N · consequence applied by code: reportable for ES (DL-EXPIRED-NEW)'.
items.data_source: QueueAsync Status, ClosedAt, ExpiredAt, DueAt, ReportableFor, OutcomeRuleId; Proof via GetAsync for closed cases

items.title: Filming checklist still says Romanian UI; S1 must be filmed before any clock move
items.evidence: PITCH.md:313 'interfața în RO' and SUBMISSION.md:34 'Interfața în română (implicit)', but the video must be in English. The demo date offset lives only in memory (SimClock.cs:22-28), and the seeded cases expire at day 85.
items.proposal: Change both checklists to an EN UI (RO/EN button, cookie app_lang=en). Film S1 right after Settings > Reset demo data, before any Demo-menu move. Reload at record start so the band animates. Check the first fold at 1080p / 125% (about 1536x776 CSS px). Reset again before the jury's live demo.

items.title: /cases header row has no padding: first label clipped, columns 16px off
items.evidence: CasesPage.razor:54: the header div has no app-list-row class. app.css:569-570: .crs-queue-head has no padding and no align-items. Screenshot /tmp/fe-shots/03-cases.png shows 'ase and client' cut at the rounded corner.
items.proposal: .crs-queue-head { padding: 0 16px; align-items: center; } A 5-minute CSS fix; check it in dark mode.

items.title: Empty 'Closed or expired' view says 'Nothing matches / clear the search' with no search
items.evidence: CasesPage.razor:47-50: shown.Count == 0 always shows the filtered-empty copy. Live EN /cases?view=done (0 cases) shows 'Try another filter or clear the search.' although nothing was searched.
items.proposal: When _search is empty, use per-view copy: done -> 'No case closed or expired yet. A case closes when a person approves the closing with proof, or expires on its deadline.'; approval -> 'No letter waiting for approval.'; urgent -> 'No deadline in the next 7 days.'

items.title: 'Needs approval' pill hides the Escalated status in the queue
items.evidence: CasesPage.razor:80-87: when a draft exists, the pill replaces CaseStatusPill. CRS-2026-0002 is Escalated with a system reminder draft, and the queue shows only 'Needs approval'.
items.proposal: Always show the status pill, plus a small warning pill 'Letter to approve' next to it (wraps under 960px).

items.title: No sorting on /cases
items.evidence: The header spans are aria-hidden text (CasesPage.razor:54-56). Shown() (:138-152) filters but never sorts; the order is fixed by QueueAsync (CaseService.cs:134-140). HANDOFF §7 lists it as open.
items.proposal: Make the header cells buttons with aria-sort: Deadline (default = service order, so E2E '.First' stays stable), Opened, Client, Status. Add a small Sort select under 960px, where the header is hidden (app.css:571). Keep ?sort= in the URL.

items.title: No All or Escalated view, no regime filter; the Escalated card links to the 7-day view
items.evidence: CasesPage.razor:30-34 has 4 options, and Shown() :146 has an unreachable '_ => _cases!'. Dashboard.razor:73 sends Escalated to ?view=urgent. A person can escalate with more than 7 days left (EscalateAsync, CaseService.cs:758).
items.proposal: Add 'Escalated' (Status == Escalated) and 'All' segments, regime chips CRS / FATCA / CRS + FATCA from c.Regime, and point the dashboard card to ?view=escalated.

items.title: Queue view and search are not kept in the URL
items.evidence: View is read once (CasesPage.razor:109). Switching segments does not update the URL, so Back from a case returns to the first view and the search is lost.
items.proposal: On change, call NavigationManager.NavigateTo(GetUriWithQueryParameter("view", v), replace: true); do the same for q.

items.title: Search misses the country and the short rule label shown in the tags
items.evidence: CasesPage.razor:150-151 matches code, client code, name and RuleId only. The tags read 'Address · ES', so typing 'Germany', 'Address' or 'FATCA' finds nothing.
items.proposal: Also match ind.Jurisdiction, CrsUi.Country(ind.Jurisdiction), CrsUi.ShortRule(ind.RuleId) and CrsUi.Label(c.Regime), through TextMatch.ContainsAny.

items.title: Queue rows do not say why the deadline is what it is
items.evidence: The queue carries IsPreexisting, DeadlineRuleId, DeadlineGuidePage and OpenedAt (Case.cs:21-41), but rows show only regime, indicia and days left (CasesPage.razor:61-78). CRS-2026-0001 (64 days, the 31 Dec rule) looks the same as a 90-day case.
items.proposal: Under days left: 'Day 86 of 90 · new account' (CrsUi.DayNumber) or '31 Dec rule · preexisting'. Title: 'DL-PRE-YEAR · guide p. 29 · our reading'. DaysLeft's 'p. 38' (DaysLeft.razor:4) could take DeadlineGuidePage.

items.title: Done-view rows show the deadline date, not the outcome
items.evidence: DaysLeft with Done=true shows only the due date (DaysLeft.razor:6-9; CasesPage.razor:78). After S4 the view holds Maria closed plus 4 expired seeded cases, and none of their consequences show.
items.proposal: Closed: 'Closed {date} · {n} days to spare'. Expired: 'Expired · reportable for ES', with the OutcomeRuleId in the tooltip (Lang.Pick on Outcome/OutcomeRo).
items.data_source: Case.ClosedAt, ExpiredAt, DueAt, ReportableFor, OutcomeRuleId, Outcome/OutcomeRo

items.title: Bulk actions on /cases: do not build bulk approve
items.evidence: HANDOFF §2: approval should feel like signing, with a four-eyes warning, and irreversible actions never happen in one click. Each approval is ApproveRequestAsync on one case (CaseService.cs:464). E2E takes the first a[href^='/cases/CRS-'] on /cases (CaseAgentTests.cs:48-49).
items.proposal: No bulk approve. If time allows: 'Review next' on ?view=approval, opening the first case that needs approval, and 'Export queue (CSV)' via a data: URI (code, client, regime, rules, due, status). Put new links after the list, never before it.

items.title: Agent work tile for the live demo, hidden at S1
items.evidence: The dashboard shows no agent activity. RunStore.ListAsync (RunStore.cs:77-82, registered Program.cs:91) returns runs with Agent, Input (holds the case code from SentinelActions), Steps with approvals, MaskedCount and Source.
items.proposal: 'Agent: {n} case files prepared · {k} approved by a person · {m} personal data items masked before the model · Live/Simulation'. Never say 'decided'. Hide it when there are no crs-sentinel runs.
items.data_source: RunStore.ListAsync(): Agent == "crs-sentinel", MaskedCount, Steps approvals, Source

items.title: Rules self-test chip from the evaluation, worded like S8
items.evidence: IEvaluationService.RunAsync is pure code and already runs when /metrics loads (MetricsPage.razor:157-165). CoverageTotals has Caught, Missed and FalseAlarms (EvaluationModels.cs:77-92). The dashboard has no testability signal.
items.proposal: After the first render, run once in the background: 'Rules self-test: {caught} of {expected} caught · {fa} false alarms', linking to /metrics. Never '100% accuracy'. Needs owner: R5 must confirm the wording and that the cost is fine on Render.

items.title: Deadline bars jump instead of sliding when the demo date moves
items.evidence: .crs-due-bar i has only a from-0 keyframe (app.css:589-596). On a CrsSignals reload, --p changes instantly.
items.proposal: Add transition: transform 1100ms var(--crs-out) on .crs-due-bar i; the reduced-motion block already zeroes it (app.css:620-622). Live demo: Demo > +7 days on the dashboard and the bars slide while the DaysLeft pills swap.

items.title: Dashboard does not refresh when the watcher acts on its own
items.evidence: Only CrsSignals reloads the page (Dashboard.razor:170-174, CasesPage.razor:110-114). DeadlineWatcher ticks every 30 s (DeadlineWatcher.cs:18,64) and notifies no UI. This is rare on the demo path, which uses MoveClockAsync.
items.proposal: A PeriodicTimer (30 s) that reloads while the page is open, disposed in Dispose. No backend change needed.

items.title: BACKEND GAP: the queue is shallow, so drafts need one GetAsync per open case
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:186-189 and CasesPage.razor:124-127 call GetAsync for each open case to find drafts. QueueAsync includes Indicia only (CaseService.cs:125). Fine at 7-12 cases, wrong for a bank.
items.proposal: Smallest change (R2): in QueueAsync add .Include(c => c.Requests.Where(r => r.Status == RequestStatus.Draft)), or a new Task<IReadOnlySet<string>> CasesWithDraftsAsync(). Not before 08:00.

items.title: BACKEND GAP: no change list with decisions; the dashboard parses audit JSON
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:193-221 parses the change.received PayloadJson (take 500 entries, then 50 rows). IChangeService.ListAsync returns ChangeEvent without its Decision (ChangeService.cs:174-185).
items.proposal: Backend: return Decision and EngineVersion from RuleEvaluation (join on EvaluationId) in ListAsync, or add DecisionCountsAsync(). Frontend meanwhile: take 5000 and drop Take(50) for the counts.

items.title: BACKEND GAP: time to decision and human or agent effort cannot be measured honestly
items.evidence: Audit At comes from the simulated clock (AuditLog.cs:105-109), and the demo jumps +85 d. A change.received and its decision are written in one operation (ChangeService.cs:98,141), so the gap is 0 s. EvaluationService.cs:415: 'agent runs are not linked to cases'.
items.proposal: In the UI, say 'decided on receipt · 0 waiting' and show no duration. Smallest backend change (R5/R2): put the case code on AgentRun, and real elapsed ms in the request.approved / case.closed payloads.

items.title: Starter 'Agents' nav group visible in every dashboard shot
items.evidence: SiteConfig.cs:165-166: group 'Agents' (Agent runs, Architecture) sits in the sidebar of the S1 frame, a starter leftover (HANDOFF §7).
items.proposal: Rename the group to 'How it works', or move Architecture under CRS and Agent runs under Account. Labels only; keep the hrefs (E2E). Coordinate with the shell or architecture owner.

items.title: 'New change' call to action shown to the viewer role
items.evidence: Dashboard.razor:21 and CasesPage.razor:14 render it for every role; ChangeService.RecordAsync requires Admin or Member (ChangeService.cs:52). HANDOFF §4 asks to mirror roles in the UI.
items.proposal: Hide it for Roles.Viewer, using the _user the dashboard already loads and CurrentUser on /cases.

items.title: Intake breadth chips: changes by channel and by kind
items.evidence: Every change.received payload has channel and kind (ChangeService.cs:141-148); today they show only per row in Recent changes. Skip AreaChart/StatCard Series: 14 changes over about 8 months would draw a flat line.
items.proposal: One small row of chips: 'Branch 4 · Online 8 · Call center 2' and 'Address · Phone · Standing order · Power of attorney · Self-certification · Document', showing that one screen covers every source.
items.data_source: change.received payload channel, kind; CrsUi.Channel, CrsUi.Label(ChangeKind)

items.title: Optional after-frame: dashboard after the run, before the logo
items.evidence: PITCH.md S9 shows only the logo and URL. After S4-S6 the real data has Maria closed with proof, the trap decisions, 1 shield alert and a verified chain, but also 4 expired seeded cases (see the expired-outcomes item).
items.proposal: A 2-3 s cut of the dashboard after S6, only if the expired outcomes read as 'consequence applied by code'. Otherwise skip it. Voice unchanged.

items.title: FATCA cases carry a 'CRS-' code next to a FATCA pill; do not rename before 08:00
items.evidence: Live EN /cases: 'CRS-2026-0005 · FATCA'. Codes come from CaseService.NextCodeAsync (CaseService.cs:325). Every E2E test selects a[href^='/cases/CRS-'] (CaseAgentTests.cs:16,49; ChangeDecisionTests.cs:25).
items.proposal: Leave the codes as they are. Optional UI change: drop the redundant 'CRS' pill on CRS rows and keep it only for FATCA and CRS + FATCA. Post-hackathon backend: a regime-neutral prefix, with the tests updated.
